cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > General
s: All resin stoppers must be used in conjunction with a 14 mm (9/16”) outer diameter (O/D) Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube.
The tube must be applied on the original static mixer of an AnchorFix® product.
Installation procedure
Insert resin stopper to bottom of the hole. Pump resin material and allow the hole to fill.
Always insert the Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube so that it is flush with the outlet of the resin stopper. After use, wipe resin stopper clean with a damp cloth and reuse.
Only use original Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers
